title: double view of IE's and KH's in addition with to long numbers if come from Nightscout/AAPS
symptom: When maintaining therapeutic data (injections and carbohydrates) in a looping setup, these appear doubled in xDrip, and sometimes the view switches to very long numbers after the decimal point.
cause: xDrip receives treatments directly from AAPS, and if the download from Nightscout is also activated, the data is shown as a double entry.
fix: Deactivate the Nightscout download setting in xDrip so that xDrip only uploads data to Nightscout and does not download it, preventing the double entries.
evidence_quote: It looks like that xdrip gets the treatments directly from AAPS, and if the download from Nightscout is activated, then it will be shown as a double entry. Local fix for me: deactivate that setting, so xdrip will in future only upload the data to nightscout, and not vice versa.
